verdict.rationale: monday.com documents event-driven automation: workflows can run the moment data changes, apps can subscribe to events like `create_item` and `change_column_value`, agents fire when messaged, assigned, or mentioned, and 2-way syncs can trigger automations. It also ships reusable workflow blocks, scheduled automations, and agents where you "set the rules." missing for 10: explicit documentation of a user-facing when-X-then-Y rule builder (much of the event evidence is developer-oriented), detail on available triggers/conditions/actions, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
